SELECT
    channel,
    average_transaction_value
FROM
(
    SELECT
        'Online' AS channel,
        sum(SalesAmount) / nullIf(countDistinct(SalesOrderNumber), 0) AS average_transaction_value
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        'Store' AS channel,
        sum(fs.SalesAmount) / nullIf(countDistinct(fs.SalesKey), 0) AS average_transaction_value
    FROM retail.FactSales AS fs
    INNER JOIN retail.DimChannel AS dc
        ON fs.channelKey = dc.ChannelKey
    WHERE dc.ChannelName = 'Store'
)
ORDER BY channel;
